race.description: Summer Barefoot Bowls @ Port City Bowling Club Mdn Plate
race.comment: BLIGHTY BOY (9) ran well in the market at his only outing at Newcastle so this theoretically should be easier. Has trialled very strongly in readiness for this race. From the barrier has to be the first one to note. DIRTY DANI (4) showed enough at her last runs when leading to say she has to be a factor. Has been close up in both trials as well. RUBINSKY (6) will be better placed sitting up on the speed. She hasn't drawn well but any luck early sees her right there for some time. TIFFY (8) is a former Gary Portelli-trained runner now lining up for the Peter Snowden stable. Her recent trial was solid at this track and while she has been off the scene for a while, she can show some promise on resumption.
